errors.evidence: The vertical axis shows nine categories, not eight. The machine-generated description omits one category.

The description does not explicitly mention the asterisks (*) next to some category labels, though it notes their presence without explanation. The atom specifies these as part of the visual structure.

For 'Erwartetes Geschäftsvolumen: fallend', the image shows values closer to 18% (Mindestlohnbetriebe) and 22% (übrige Betriebe), not 20% and 17%. The description reverses the values for the two groups.
For 'Beschäftigungserwartung: steigend', the image shows values closer to 14% (Mindestlohnbetriebe) and 17% (übrige Betriebe). The description underreports the Mindestlohnbetriebe value by 1%.
The description does not explicitly state the y-axis label ('in %'), though it mentions values are in percent.
